description: Support copying and/or moving only if these operations are clear and meaningful for your type. Avoid slicing by making base classes abstract.

semgrep.limitations: requires type resolution to check inheritance and special member functions

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support C/C++ analysis

codeql.limitations: requires custom query to check for meaningful copy/move semantics

description: Local variables should be declared in the narrowest scope possible, as close to first use as possible, and initialized in the declaration.

semgrep.limitations: May not detect all cases where assignment is far from declaration.

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support C/C++ analysis.

codeql.limitations: Requires custom query to detect distance between declaration and first use.

description: Use default capture by value ([=]) sparingly. Prefer explicit captures. Avoid long lambdas with [=] and do not capture 'this' implicitly.

semgrep.limitations: Can detect the pattern but cannot reliably assess lambda length or implicit 'this' capture context.

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support C/C++ analysis.

codeql.limitations: Can detect default capture but requires custom query for assessing 'sparing use' and lambda length.

description: Prefer to define non-modifying binary operators as non-member functions to allow implicit conversions on both sides.

semgrep.limitations: requires pattern to distinguish member vs non-member operators

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support C/C++ analysis

codeql.limitations: requires type resolution to confirm operator modifies state

description: Detect complex or non-obvious code sections that lack explanatory comments.

semgrep.limitations: Complexity detection and comment association require custom logic.

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support C/C++ analysis.

codeql.limitations: Requires custom query to correlate complexity metrics with comment presence.

description: Use only approved subset of Boost libraries (listed in guide).

semgrep.limitations: requires external list of approved libraries for condition

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support C/C++ analysis

codeql.limitations: requires custom query with external data source for approved list

description: Use C++-style casts (static_cast, const_cast, reinterpret_cast, std::bit_cast). Do not use C-style casts except to void. Brace initialization is allowed for arithmetic conversions.

semgrep.limitations: May match false positives in macro expansions or complex type expressions.

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support C/C++ analysis.

codeql.limitations: Requires custom query to exclude casts to void and brace initialization.

description: TODO comments must include 'TODO' in all caps, followed by a bug ID, name, email, or other identifier, and include a specific date or event.

semgrep.limitations: Pattern matches only simple '// TODO:' prefix; complex format validation (identifier, date) requires custom logic.

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support C/C++ analysis.

codeql.limitations: Requires custom query to enforce specific comment content format.

description: Type conversion operators and constructors callable with a single argument must be marked explicit. Copy/move constructors are exceptions.

semgrep.limitations: requires type resolution to identify copy/move constructors and to confirm single-argument callability

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support C/C++ analysis

codeql.limitations: requires custom query to detect missing explicit and exclude copy/move constructors

description: Constructors should never call virtual functions, because they will not dispatch to subclass implementations.

semgrep.limitations: requires type resolution to confirm virtual method

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support C/C++ analysis

description: New-style switch rule can be written on a single line if it follows Google style (no column overflow; if non-empty block, line break after {). Continuation lines indent +4.

semgrep.limitations: formatting rules (line length, indentation) require custom checks beyond AST matching

pmd.limitations: requires custom rule for line length and block formatting

codeql.limitations: formatting rules are not a primary focus of CodeQL

description: JUnit test method names may contain underscores to separate logical components, each component in lowerCamelCase.

semgrep.limitations: regex-based detection may not capture all valid lowerCamelCase components

pmd.limitations: requires custom rule for naming pattern with underscores

codeql.limitations: requires custom query for naming convention

description: Local variables should be declared close to their first use, not habitually at the start of a block, to minimize their scope.

semgrep.limitations: Distance heuristic is approximate; may have false positives/negatives.

pmd.limitations: PMD's LocalVariableCouldBeFinal rule is related but not identical. Requires custom rule for distance check.

codeql.limitations: Can compute variable use distances but requires custom query for this specific style rule.

description: Class members and initializers should follow a logical order that the maintainer could explain, not chronological by date added. Do not habitually add new methods to the end.

semgrep.limitations: Semgrep cannot enforce logical ordering of class members.

pmd.limitations: PMD does not have a built-in rule for logical class member ordering; requires custom rule.

codeql.limitations: CodeQL cannot enforce logical ordering of class members.

description: Methods with the same name must appear in a single contiguous group with no other members in between. Same for constructors. Applies even when modifiers differ.

semgrep.limitations: requires custom logic to detect non-contiguous groups of same-name methods

pmd.limitations: requires custom rule implementation

codeql.limitations: requires query to check ordering of class members

description: Detect use of old-style colon syntax in switch statements where new-style arrow syntax is required (e.g., in switch expressions).

semgrep.limitations: requires precise detection of switch expression context

pmd.limitations: PMD has rules for switch syntax but may not distinguish expression context

codeql.limitations: requires custom query to detect colon in switch expressions

description: Detect mixing of new-style switch rules (label ->) and old-style statement groups (label:) within the same switch block.

semgrep.limitations: requires pattern matching for both switch rule and statement group syntax

pmd.limitations: PMD may have existing rules for switch style but not specifically for mixing

codeql.limitations: requires AST query to differentiate switch case types

description: Detects a block used where a single statement is allowed, which is permitted by K&R style to limit local variable scope.

semgrep.limitations: requires precise detection of single-statement contexts (e.g., after if, for, while)

pmd.limitations: PMD's rule 'UnnecessaryBlock' flags the opposite case; custom rule needed for this exception.

codeql.limitations: requires custom query to identify blocks in single-statement contexts

description: Convert phrase to plain ASCII and remove apostrophes. Example: 'Müller's algorithm' → 'Muellers algorithm'

semgrep.limitations: Semgrep is not designed for text normalization or encoding transformations.

pmd.limitations: PMD is not designed for text normalization or encoding transformations.

codeql.limitations: CodeQL is not designed for text normalization or encoding transformations.

description: Type-use annotations must appear immediately before the annotated type and be meta-annotated with @Target(ElementType.TYPE_USE).

semgrep.limitations: requires type resolution to verify @Target meta-annotation

pmd.limitations: requires custom rule to check annotation target

codeql.limitations: requires query to check annotation position and meta-annotation

description: Prefer `for-of` loops for iterating over arrays and iterables. `for-in` loops should only be used for dict-style objects and must use `hasOwnProperty` check.

semgrep.limitations: Type constraint for array detection may be limited without type resolution.

pmd.limitations: PMD has a rule 'ForLoopShouldBeWhileLoop' but not a specific rule for preferring for-of.

codeql.limitations: Requires type resolution to distinguish arrays from objects.

description: Detect usage of the native Error constructor where a custom exception class extending Error should be defined and used instead.

semgrep.limitations: Inheritance check for custom exceptions may be limited without deeper type analysis.

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support JavaScript analysis.

codeql.limitations: Requires custom query to check if a thrown Error is an instance of a user-defined subclass.

description: Use spread operator `...` to flatten iterables. Prefer over `Array.prototype.slice` or `concat`. No space after `...`.

semgrep.limitations: Cannot enforce preference; only detects slice usage.

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support JavaScript analysis.

codeql.limitations: Requires custom query to detect slice/concat usage and suggest spread.

description: Do not use variadic `Array` constructor; error-prone. Use literal instead. Explicit allocation `new Array(length)` is allowed.

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support JavaScript analysis

description: Do not access `this` in static methods. Use the class name instead.

semgrep.limitations: requires pattern matching for `this` keyword in static method body

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support JavaScript analysis

codeql.limitations: requires custom query for static method detection and `this` access

description: Use `this` only in class constructors/methods, arrow functions defined within them, or functions with explicit `@this` annotation. Never for global object, `eval`, event target, or unnecessary `call`/`apply`.

semgrep.limitations: requires complex pattern matching for context and may have false positives/negatives

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support JavaScript analysis

codeql.limitations: requires custom query for `@this` annotation and arrow function context

description: Top-level functions may be defined directly on `exports` object, or declared locally and exported.

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support JavaScript analysis

description: Detects enumerations defined by adding a JSDoc `@enum` annotation to an object literal. The object must be module-local or on `exports`, its values must be string literals or numbers, and no additional properties should be added after its definition.

semgrep.limitations: Semgrep can match the pattern but may not fully validate all property values are literals or the constant scope.

codeql.limitations: Requires custom query to check for @enum annotation and object literal properties.

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support JavaScript analysis.

description: Declare all local variables with `const` or `let`. Use `const` by default unless variable needs reassignment. `var` must not be used.

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support JavaScript analysis

description: Use template literals `` `...` `` over complex string concatenation, especially with multiple literals. May span multiple lines.

semgrep.limitations: type resolution for string detection may be limited

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support JavaScript analysis

codeql.limitations: requires type inference for string operands

description: Python filenames must have .py extension and must not contain dashes (-).

semgrep.limitations: requires custom file property rule

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support Python analysis

codeql.limitations: requires custom query for file properties

description: Imports must be placed at the top of the file, after module comments/docstrings and before globals. They should be grouped from most generic to least generic: __future__, standard library, third-party, sub-package.

semgrep.limitations: requires custom rule to check import ordering and placement relative to other statements

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support Python analysis

codeql.limitations: requires custom query to enforce import ordering and placement

description: The Returns section is not required if the function only returns None.

semgrep.limitations: Type resolution needed to confirm function returns None.

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support Python analysis.

codeql.limitations: Requires custom query to check docstring content against return type.

description: Check that identifiers follow Guido's naming conventions: packages `lower_with_under`, classes `CapWords`, exceptions `CapWords`, functions `lower_with_under()`, constants `CAPS_WITH_UNDER`. Internal versions prefix `_`.

semgrep.limitations: requires custom rules for each identifier type and scope

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support Python analysis

codeql.limitations: requires custom query for each naming pattern

description: TODO comments must use the format `TODO: resource - explanation`. Avoid old style `TODO(username):`.

semgrep.limitations: pattern may match correct format but cannot enforce resource link validity or fully detect old style TODOs without additional patterns.

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support Python analysis.

codeql.limitations: requires custom query to check comment text format.

description: Classes should have a docstring below the class definition describing the class. Document public attributes in an `Attributes:` section.

semgrep.limitations: requires custom logic to detect missing docstrings

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support Python analysis

codeql.limitations: requires custom query to check for docstring presence

description: For logging functions that expect a pattern-string, always call them with a string literal (not f-string) as first argument.

semgrep.limitations: requires custom pattern to detect non-literal first arguments

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support Python analysis

codeql.limitations: requires custom query to detect logging calls with non-literal format strings

description: Detect forward references to class names without using `from __future__ import annotations` or string literals.

semgrep.limitations: Type resolution needed to confirm forward reference; pattern may match many identifiers.

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support Python analysis.

codeql.limitations: Requires type resolution and may need custom query for forward reference detection.

description: Function docstring must contain sections for Args, Returns (or Yields), and Raises with appropriate hanging indent.

semgrep.limitations: cannot fully validate section content and hanging indent format

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support Python analysis

codeql.limitations: requires custom query for docstring structure validation

description: Within each grouping, imports should be sorted lexicographically, ignoring case, according to full package path.

semgrep.limitations: requires custom rule with metavariable-comparison or external script

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support Python analysis

codeql.limitations: requires custom query to compare import order

description: Avoid using the external program `expr` for arithmetic; built-in shell arithmetic is many times faster.

semgrep.limitations: pattern may match non-arithmetic uses of expr (e.g., string operations)

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support shell script analysis

codeql.limitations: CodeQL does not support shell script analysis

description: The main program should be in a function called 'main' defined as the bottom-most function in the file.

semgrep.limitations: requires pattern to check relative position of function definitions

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support shell script analysis

codeql.limitations: requires custom query to check function ordering

description: Never use the `let` builtin. Use `(( ... ))` instead.

semgrep.limitations: requires semgrep-shell support for builtin detection

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support shell analysis

codeql.limitations: CodeQL does not support shell analysis

description: When using the regex matching operator `=~` inside `[[ ... ]]`, the right-hand side (RHS) should not be quoted, as quoting would treat the pattern as a literal string.

semgrep.limitations: Semgrep's Bash/Shell parsing may not fully distinguish all quoting contexts for regex patterns.

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support Shell/Bash analysis.

codeql.limitations: CodeQL does not support Shell/Bash analysis.

description: Arrays should not be used to facilitate more complex data structures; use appropriate collection types instead.

semgrep.limitations: pattern matches array declarations but cannot infer if they are used for complex structures

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support shell script analysis

codeql.limitations: CodeQL does not support shell script analysis

description: Inside arithmetic evaluation `(( ... ))`, variables should be referenced by name without the `$` prefix.

semgrep.limitations: requires precise pattern for variable names with $ prefix

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support shell script analysis

codeql.limitations: CodeQL does not support shell script analysis

description: The ShellCheck project identifies common bugs and warnings; recommended for all scripts, large or small.

semgrep.limitations: Semgrep cannot enforce the use of an external tool like ShellCheck.

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support shell script analysis.

codeql.limitations: CodeQL does not support shell script analysis.

description: Use the `=~` operator for regex matching within `[[ ... ]]` conditional constructs. The right-hand side of the operator should not be quoted.

semgrep.limitations: Semgrep's Bash/Shell support is limited; pattern may not correctly enforce the RHS quoting constraint in all cases.

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support Shell/Bash analysis.

codeql.limitations: CodeQL does not support Shell/Bash analysis.

description: After a command substitution like `my_var="$(my_func)"`, check `$?` because `local` would have swallowed it. Use `(( $? == 0 )) || return`.

semgrep.limitations: Pattern matches assignment but cannot enforce presence of subsequent error check.

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support shell script analysis.

codeql.limitations: CodeQL does not support shell script analysis.

description: Always separate `local` declaration and assignment when assignment uses command substitution, because `local` masks exit code.

semgrep.limitations: requires pattern matching for command substitution syntax

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support shell script analysis

codeql.limitations: CodeQL does not support shell script analysis
